data.name: Azeema
data.gender_notes: Azeema is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Azeema is an Arabic name that means 'resolute', 'determined', or 'possessing great resolve'. It symbolizes a strong-willed and focused woman who faces challenges with faith and strength. The name Azeema carries the meaning “Resolute, Determined, Great” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Azeema usually hope their child will grow to embody resolute, determined, great and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents inner strength, resilience, and divine determination to fulfill higher purpose.
data.etymology: Azeema belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Resolute, Determined, Great.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azeema total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: عزيمة
in_arabic.long_meaning: العزيمة اسمُ مؤنث من أصل عربي معناهُ "القوة" و"الكبرياء" و"التفوق" و"الجرأة". فُسّرت في القران الكريم في سورة "الفرقان" الآية 48 حيث تقول "فَتَوَفَّقْنَا لَهَا فِيهِ بِعِزَّانِ فَفَنَّتْ فِي عِزْمِهَا" . وفي السنة النبوية عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم "عزمتُ على اللهِ، فَأَوْجِدْتُهُ عَزِيزَ" . ويرمز الاسم إلى الشخصية القوية، الذاتية، الواثقة من نفسها، وهي صفةٌ مرغوبة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: عزیمہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: عزیمہ ایک اردو نام ہے جو عربی سے آیا ہے۔ اس کا معنی "بہادری، شجاعت، و عظمت" ہے۔ یہ نام قرآن میں بھی آیا ہے جہاں اللہ تعالیٰ نے ان لوگوں کو عزیمہ سے نوازا ہے جنہوں نے اسلام کی راہ پر قدم رکھا ہے۔ یہ نام یہی ارادہ سے ہے کہ بچہ ایک مضبوط، شجاع اور عظیم شخص بنے۔

in_hindi.name: अज़ीमा
in_hindi.long_meaning: अज़ीमा एक अरबी मूल का नाम है जिसका अर्थ है 'शक्ति', 'बहादुरी', 'उत्कृष्टता' और 'महानता'. यह नाम कुरान में भी आता है जहाँ अल्लाह ने उन लोगों को अज़ीमा से नवाजा है जो इस्लाम के रास्ते पर चलें। यह नाम एक मजबूत, बहादुर और महान व्यक्ति बनने की इच्छा रखता है।

in_pashto.name: عزيمه
in_pashto.long_meaning: عزيمه د پښتو ژبه کې يوه نومونه ده چې معنا يې "قوه، غزیر، ستر، بلند" دى. دې نوم قرآن کریم کې هم راځي، چې په دې کې دې دې نومونه راځي چې دې خپلې نوموړې نړۍ ته په ښه ډول غوره کړې.

in_english.name: Azeema
in_english.long_meaning: Azeema is an Arabic name meaning 'powerful,' 'strong,' 'majestic,' and 'dignified.' It derives from the Arabic root 'azma,' meaning 'greatness' or 'excellence.' In Islamic tradition, Azeema is associated with strength of character, resilience, and spiritual fortitude. The name is often bestowed upon girls to signify their potential for greatness and their ability to overcome challenges.

data.cultural_impact: The name Azeema holds a profound cultural significance, as it reflects the values of resolve, determination, and strength that are highly regarded in Islamic and Arabic societies. Naming a child Azeema meant that they would be instilled with these qualities from an early age, and their families and community would encourage and support their development as strong, resilient individuals.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Azeema signifies a woman who embodies unwavering faith and commitment to her beliefs. This can manifest in various ways, such as dealing with trials and struggles with patience, persevering in religious practices, or inspiring others with her unwavering faith and determination. The name is a reminder that, with determination and faith, one can overcome even the greatest challenges and remain steadfast in their convictions.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Azeema is derived from the Arabic word "azima," which means 'lofty' or 'exalted.' It represents an individual who is continuously striving for spiritual heights and seeking closeness to Allah, raising their status in His sight.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Azeema was a wife of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Azeema carried significant weight in that era.
